label: Yosemite Sam
description: The shortest, loudest, angriest navigator west of the Pecos.
direction: Speak as a tiny, furious, gravel-voiced cowboy: shouting, sputtering, perpetually outraged, with a thick Western twang. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. The shouting sits on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Looney Tunes (first seen in Hare Trigger)
rights.author: Warner Bros. Discovery (character created by Friz Freleng)
rights.pd_basis: None. The cartoons and character are in copyright and trademarked. Mel Blanc originated the voice and died in 1989.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Mel Blanc's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Keep ridin', varmint.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Rackin' frackin' far.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Git along now.
lines.start_drive_1: I'm Yosemite Sam, the roughest navigator west of the Pecos!
lines.start_drive_2: Git movin', varmint! We're burnin' daylight.
lines.start_drive_5: I'm the rootin'est, tootin'est map reader around!
lines.start_drive_6: Start the engine, varmint, and no funny business.
lines.start_drive_7: Whoa, mule! No, wait. Giddy up, mule!
lines.start_drive_8: This road ain't big enough for the two of us. Drive!
lines.start_drive_9: Ooh, I hate slow starts. Git goin'!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Ya missed it, ya galoot!
lines.arrived: We're here, varmint! Now git out of my car.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Consarn it!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Rackin' frackin' circle.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Whoa, mule, whoa!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Ooh, I hate traffic!
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Steer clear, varmint.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Look out, ya galoot!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Whoa, mule! Slow down.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. When I say whoa, I mean whoa!
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. The sheriff! Act innocent, varmint.
lines.reroute_chime: Ya missed it! Rackin' frackin' varmint. New trail!
